description: React component for managing workout programs in a gym management system. It allows trainers to list templates, select clients, create new workout programs, and generate program days based on date ranges or auto mode. The component interacts with various API endpoints to fetch templates, clients, and existing programs, and to create or generate program days.

classes.name: ProgramBuilder
classes.description: React functional component for building and managing workout programs for gym clients.

methods.name: loadTemplates
methods.description: Fetches workout templates from the API and updates state.

methods.name: loadClients
methods.description: Fetches trainer's clients from the API and updates state.

methods.name: loadProgramsForMember
methods.description: Fetches existing programs for a selected member.

methods.name: createProgram
methods.description: Creates a new workout program for the selected member based on selected template and input data.

methods.name: generateDays
methods.description: Generates program days for a specific program, either automatically or within a date range.
